title: Set Operations (UNION, INTERSECT, EXCEPT)
description: You have two tables: active_users and archived_users. Find all email addresses that appear in BOTH tables (INTERSECT), and also find emails that are in active_users but NOT in archived_users (EXCEPT).
hints: Use INTERSECT to find common emails
Use EXCEPT to find emails only in active
Both SELECT statements must return the same number of columns
